question: Among female patients who had laboratory tests in 1984 and were younger than 50 years old at the time of testing, identify those with either abnormal total cholesterol (T-CHO ≥ 250) or abnormal uric acid levels (UA > 6.5). Return their patient IDs, sex, birthday, diagnosis, and the date of the qualifying laboratory test, sorted by birthday in ascending order.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    P."XCL_058",
    P."XCL_059",
    P."XCL_060",
    P."XCL_064",
    L."XCL_015"
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L
  ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND L."XCL_015" >= '1984-01-01'
  AND L."XCL_015" < '1985-01-01'
  AND (strftime('%Y', L."XCL_015") - strftime('%Y', P."XCL_060")) < 50
  AND (L."XCL_026" >= 250 OR L."XCL_022" > 6.5)
ORDER BY P."XCL_060" ASC;
